oxbow.definition:
n. the land inside an oxbow bend in a river
n. a U-shaped curve in a stream
n. a wooden framework bent in the shape of a U; its upper ends are attached to the horizontal yoke and the loop goes around the neck of an ox
oxbow.translation:
n. 牛轭U字形部分, U字形弯曲
a. 呈U字形弯曲的

oxbows.definition:

oxbows.translation:

oxbridge.definition: n. general term for an ancient and prestigious and privileged university (especially Oxford University or Cambridge University)
oxbridge.translation: n. 牛津和剑桥大学, 牛津或剑桥大学
